author: श्रीराघवेन्द्रस्वामी
commentary: ननु जीवचितः कालकृतस्य बिम्बनाशादिनिमित्तकृतस्य च नाशस्याभावेऽपि दक्षशिरच्छेद इव शास्त्रादिप्रबलहेतुना नाशोऽस्ति किमित्यत आह ॥ नैनमिति । एनं देहीति प्रकृतं जीवं न क्लेदयन्ति । मृदुकरणेन शिथिलं न कुर्वन्तीत्यर्थः ॥ २.२३॥
translation:
Weapons do not cut him, fire does not burn him, waters do not wet him, wind does not dry him (-him who is the dweller in the body). (23)
V. Do not wet him: do not soften the substances so as to be pulled to pieces. (23) 
A. The use of the present tense in the above statement might still leave a doubt that though the Jiva cannot be injured at the present, he might be at some future. So, it is necessary to affirm of the Jiva such a nature as is impossible to be affected by any causes at any time, for which purpose the following statement is made.
